titles.display: Faroe Islands Premier League

extract: The Faroe Islands Premier League is the top level of football in the Faroe Islands. It was founded in 1942 as Meistaradeildin, and has been played in its current format since 2005, when the Premier League replaced 1. deild as the country's top football division. The league is organised by the Faroe Islands Football Association.
